name: Adaptive Volume Renderer (AVR)
aliases: Adapted version of differentiable ray marching algorithm
definition: A rendering procedure that combines adaptive ray sampling with standard volume rendering to reduce computational cost while maintaining quality. It uses an LSTM to predict a surface intersection point, then samples points around that point for volume rendering.
summary: The Adaptive Volume Renderer combines adaptive ray marching with volume rendering to achieve standard quality at seven times the speed by using an LSTM to predict depth and sample locally.
